limitations: Original input-manager binding/axis/joystick production and full application startup remain unfinished.

Keyboard device creation/data format/cooperative ownership and final close are delegated original LS3DF calls; key snapshots, reacquisition, scan selection, modifier flags and character lookup are reconstructed.

Host keyboard bridge uses foreground nonexclusive flags zero without repeat; alternate non-engine-mouse paths retain Win32 message transport. Debug toggle state is native and is not connected to original debug rendering.

The immutable original scan table is copied from the fingerprinted loaded DLL; no original keyboard mutable globals are read for selection except configuration at startup and the borrowed device pointer.
Frame clock retains original timer-failure behavior; unavailable event/performance-clock setup throws.
